LegacyLineage.description:
Read from a legacy archive object. What it lacks is ``Unknown`` on the
record; layer 3 labels anything it derives from it as legacy-derived.

row_index.description: Position of the row in that object; null when it holds one.
row_index.title: Row Index

source_key.description: The legacy object the record came from.
source_key.title: Source Key

LegacyLineage.title: LegacyLineage

LegacyPeriod.description:
The UTC days ``[start, end)`` for which a legacy archive stands in for
the recorder's records.

anyOf.description: ISO date of a UTC calendar day (never a service day).

end.description: Exclusive: the first UTC day the recorder wrote the replacing record; null while it has not.
end.title: End

start.description: First UTC day the legacy archive covers.
start.title: Start

LegacyPeriod.title: LegacyPeriod

RouteAlertGranularity.description:
What a ``v1/predictions`` row holds: per route, per 5-minute tick, the
single highest-priority alert type, with no alert identity.
RouteAlertGranularity.title: RouteAlertGranularity

description:
Lossy legacy alert state read from ``v1/predictions``. Use only for
days without ``AlertPresence``; a bound derived from it is legacy-derived.
It can bound a route-level alert end, never an alert version end.

primary_alert_type.description: null = the route had an inference row and no active alert.
primary_alert_type.title: Primary Alert Type

route_id.description: The prediction row's route, as written.
route_id.title: Route Id

title: LegacyRouteAlertState
